summary: Privacy choices card whose shield fills as categories are allowed; saving stamps it and folds the card into a small Change pill.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Card title; also labels the card region. Observed.

attributes.name: description
attributes.default: We only use what you allow. You can change this any time in Settings.

events.name: consent
events.description: Fires on Reject all, Save choices or Accept all with the chosen categories. Necessary is always on and not reported.

accessibility: The card is a `role="region"` labelled by its title.
Categories are native checkboxes styled as switches, each inside a `<label>` with its description; Necessary is checked and disabled.

After saving, the card is replaced by a pill reading `Saved · <n> of 3 categories on` with a Change button. When focus was on one of the card's buttons, it moves to Change. Change moves focus to Save choices.
The shield is drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, the shield level changes at once, there is no stamp ring and the card folds immediately.
notes: The component does not store choices or set cookies; persist the `consent` detail yourself. It always starts with Analytics and Personalisation off.
The categories are fixed: Necessary, Analytics and Personalisation.
Without reduced motion, the shield redraws every frame while the element is visible.
